Description: Import delivery order issued electronically to consignee/forwarder
As a GHA import agent, I want to issue an e-DO once all charges are paid, so that the forwarder can collect cargo without visiting the counter.
Acceptance Criteria: Given AWB 000-00000000 has status RCF and charges paid | When the agent clicks Issue e-DO | Then an e-DO number is generated and sent to the forwarder

Description: As a GHA import agent, I want e-DO issuance blocked while charges are unpaid, so that revenue is not lost.
Acceptance Criteria: Given AWB 000-00000000 has unpaid storage charges | When the agent clicks Issue e-DO | Then issuance is refused with message 'Charges pending'
